description: Main application file for a React-based frontend, setting up routing, layout, theme toggling, authentication guards, and user/session management.

classes.name: SessionState
classes.description: Interface representing the user's session state, including user ID and email.

classes.name: AppAuthState
classes.description: Interface extending SessionState with additional admin status, used as a singleton store.

classes.name: GuardedRouteProps
classes.description: Props for the route guarding component, specifying element, auth requirement, and admin-only restriction.

methods.name: setAppAuthState
methods.description: Updates the singleton app authentication state and notifies listeners.

methods.name: useIsAdmin
methods.description: Custom hook to derive the isAdmin state from the singleton, updating UI on change.

methods.name: AuthGuard
methods.description: Component that guards routes based on authentication and admin permissions, handling loading, timeout, and redirects.

methods.name: resolveIsAdmin
methods.description: Asynchronously determines if the current user has admin privileges via metadata or database query.
